t: The ETAL Enzo Radiator Pipe Covers and Collars Set provides a neat solution for concealing unsightly radiator pipework. These white uPVC covers are designed to hide 15mm pipework, offering a clean finish around radiators in homes and commercial properties. Each 200mm long cover is supplied with clip-on collars, effectively covering any gaps or holes in the floor or wall for a professional installation. The 16mm covers fit seamlessly onto existing pipework, enhancing the aesthetic of any room by tidying up plumbing connections.
b: Designed for Quick & Tidy Plumbing Jobs
